frozenBuild.rule: No production, calibration, metric or input changes after this point. Only report/publishing artifacts may be generated. Holdout inputs and results are never used to tune.

decision.change: Modern fictional WNBA initial roster-quality SD target rises from 1.15x to 1.40x its unallocated value, using the existing same-position swap algorithm. NBA stays at 1.15x.
decision.reason: 1.45 reached the spread target but exceeded the real 20+ ceiling; 1.35 respected the ceiling but fell below the SD target; 1.40 was borderline on the initial five seeds (SD 5.299); five additional calibration seeds 116–120 were run without a parameter change. The full ten-season calibration met both gates. No transition tuning.

synergyNBA.note: Pooled denominator inferred from team POSS / rounded POSS_PCT, hence approximate. Full-season Synergy play-type share differs from the 134-game CDN fastbreak-FGA sample and denominator; not a conversion factor.
